newsitem.title: UK: Prudential slips on broker comments.
newsitem.headline: Prudential slips on broker comments.

text.p: Shares in Prudential Corp slipped 8p to 535-1/2 by 0945 GMT after brokerage Credit Lyonnais Laing made cautious remarks about the stock, dealers said.
Credit Lyonnais Laing insurance analyst David Hudson said he told clients to switch out of Prudential following the stock's sharp run-up and into Legal & General because it offers better value.
By 0954 GMT, Prudential shares were off 8-1/2p to 535, while Legal & General shares rose 6-1/2p to 376-1/2.
Dealers said switching was evident this morning.
Hudson said he maintained both his "hold" rating on Prudential and his "buy" recommendation on Legal & General.
He also said he reduced his rating on Britannic Assurance to "hold" from "buy." Britannic shares were unchanged at 802-1/2p.
Hudson on Friday cut his rating on Sun Life & Provincial Holdings to "sell" from "hold" after the insurer released its results last week.
